metadata.dcterms:title: STACKS OF FIBER FUNCTORS AND TANNAKA’S RECONSTRUCTION
metadata.dcterms:creator: TONINI, FABIO
metadata.dcterms:abstract: Given a quasi-compact category ﬁbered in groupoids X and a monoidal subcat- egory C of its category of locally free sheaves Vect(X), we are going to introduce the stack of ﬁber functors FibX,C with source C, which comes equipped with a map PC : X →FibX,C and a functor G : C →Vect(FibX,C). If C generates QCoh(X) and X is an fpqc stack with quasi-aﬃne diagonal, we show that PC : X →FibX,C is an equivalence, as it happens by Tannaka’s reconstruction when X is an aﬃne gerbe over a ﬁeld. In general, under mild assumption on C, e.g. C = Vect(X), we show that FibX,C is a quasi-compact fpqc stack with aﬃne diagonal and that the image G(C) generates QCoh(FibX,C).
